8.39.1.1. iLock_Geography.xconfig.Geo.__init__¶

Geo.__init__(*args)¶

Constructor.

Parameters:args (vtuple(str)) – A tuple containing one or two elements. If the tuple is a singleton, the element of the tuple is a geo predicate name. If the tuple is a 2-tuple, the first element is the name of a geo type and the second element is the regex describing which parts from the geo object name (with the geo type) are used to name the corresponding PiSPEC object.
